children: The FTSE MIB rose 1% to 51,969 on Wednesday, amid gains across sectors.
Sovereign yields declined as the surge in crude prices eased, while markets awaited the Fed’s monetary policy decision after the close, with a rate hike widely expected.
Although higher rates could weigh on credit demand, financials outperformed in Milan.
Consob opened an investigation into Intesa’s (0.6%) bid for MPS (-0.1%).
Although Intesa had agreed to dispose of half of MPS’s branches, preliminary checks by the authorities indicated that the deal could still raise competition concerns regardless of the divestment.
Tech stock STMicroelectronics advanced 2%, while defense stocks Leonardo (1%) and Avio (0.4%) outperformed, driven by renewed signs of the need to rebuild Western arsenals.
Utilities also extended recent gains, led by A2A (2%).
Stellantis dropped 3.3%, while Prime Minister Meloni announced the abolition of road tax for small and medium-sized vehicles.

title: FTSE MIB Closes Higher
